name: Adie
tagline: A warm daily companion for brains that struggle with the small stuff
description: Made for people whose ADHD, anxiety or low mood turns ordinary upkeep into a wall. It checks in kindly rather than nagging, rolls up its sleeves on the tasks you are stuck on, and carries light recurring reminders such as meals, prescriptions and a friend's birthday. Support, not diagnosis.
author: Devil
